name: Ryan Bros Coffee City Heights
notes: 3 menu photos: 1.jpg is a legible digital menu board (Breakfast Sandwiches + Good for the Soul) with prices and descriptions for all items. 2.jpg (seasonal Fall latte poster) and 3.jpg (Basics/Espresso/Frappuccino/Smoothie list) are drink-only menus with no prices, skipped per rules.

dishes.name: Pop's Favorite
dishes.description: Creamy peanut butter topped with sliced banana & pure honey on your choice of Sourdough or wheat bread.

dishes.name: The Classic
dishes.description: Our own version of an all classic ham, melted cheddar cheese, and mayonnaise on your choice of bagel or croissant (add cage free egg $1.50).

dishes.name: Sunshine
dishes.description: A simply great egg, bacon, and cheddar breakfast sandwich with mayo in your choice of croissant or bagel.

dishes.name: El Chorizo
dishes.description: Chorizo and egg patty with melted mozzarella cheese, and avocado spread.

dishes.name: Jack's Pig
dishes.description: Our delicious spiced sandwich with chipotle mayonnaise, sliced ham, (2) pieces of crispy bacon, melted pepper jack cheese, and topped with avocado (add cage free egg $1.50).

dishes.name: Pesto Breakfast Sandwich
dishes.description: Organic pesto, with cage free egg, tomato, bacon, mozzarella cheese, on your option of croissant or bagel.

dishes.name: Avocado Toast
dishes.description: (2) Your choice of Sourdough or wheat bread with avocado topped with crispy bacon bits, sliced tomato, and everything seasoning.

dishes.name: Fabi's Special
dishes.description: Chipotle mayo, soy chorizo, cage free egg, ham, bacon, pepper jack cheese, and fresh avocado, served on sourdough bread.

dishes.name: Todo Bien!
dishes.description: Breakfast sandwich served on wheat bread, egg whites, spinach, and avocado (add turkey for $1.50).

dishes.name: Poseidon's Fruit Bowl
dishes.description: Organic greek yogurt topped with sliced bananas, strawberries, blueberries, and granola.

dishes.name: Acai Bowl
dishes.description: Acai Roots topped with sliced bananas, strawberries, blueberries, and granola (add peanut butter for $.50).

dishes.name: Overnight Oats
dishes.description: Whole grain oats, and chia seeds overnight with oat milk; slices of fresh banana, strawberry, and blueberries with hemp seeds on top, honey on the side (add ceremonial matcha for $1.00 / add peanut butter for $.50).

dishes.name: Garden Salad
dishes.description: Blend of power greens with sliced avocado, cucumber, feta cheese, croutons, everything seasoning, dry sunflower seeds, dry cranberries, dry pumpkin seeds, and as dressing our special coffee vinaigrette made with our house espresso.
